inspectionOrder: actual original Blender source and original native builder

observations.original: Broad cyan continuous reef slab with asymmetric top profile; three small solid faceted coral stalks read as isolated pins. Deep front face and little tiered rock structure make the slab visually plain.
observations.target: Cyan blue layered rounded reef shelves carry two violet hollow tube colonies at the front and a taller green hollow tube colony behind. Rings, visible dark inner walls, clustered related sizes, soft bevels, and rounded accent rocks provide the intended identity and crafted depth. Palette is saturated but softened through broad lighting.
observations.styleReference: The plant reference retains readable faceting with rounded edge highlights, clean material colors and broad soft light. Aim for volumes and native hollows, not painted caustics or tiny texture noise.
observations.nativeOriginal: Nine asset objects in the named native export scene: root, continuous core, three stems and tips, and a polyp. Existing terrain loft and small solid stems are a starting point; native forms can be usefully rebuilt inside the actual functional envelope.
observations.proposedDesign: Preserve finite terrain slab and native end contact surfaces, soften the inner rock surface, rebuild compact green and violet tube colonies with true recessed mouths, and add restrained rounded reef details. Keep colony grouping readable in all required rotations and at small consumer scale.

limits: This is an independent initial reading, not a candidate or visual approval.
